release_blocker_fixed: native QtCharts cockpit segmentation fault after booking refresh
root_cause: QAreaSeries did not own its locally scoped upper QLineSeries; PySide could destroy the edge series while QtCharts retained a native pointer
fixes: persistent QLineSeries reference with QObject parent
no removeAllSeries or createDefaultAxes during trend refresh
limitations: PySide6 6.10.3 was unavailable in the isolated audit environment
native Fedora QtCharts booking stress test must be performed on the target system
